designRules.rule: Every human Zelo mention is an operational request only. A contribution-offer session additionally requires explicit sell or contribute language; neither act is consent, contribution, license, assignment, sale, or payment.
Discord message content, attachments, embeds, and third-party mentions cannot cross into the commercial contribution corpus.
The broker may retain only the author and message pointer, bot mention, observation time, and hashed expiring one-time session evidence.
Contribution requires direct re-submission at TTI's HTTPS boundary under exact effective terms, a selected license, and affirmative capacity and rights attestations.
Sensitive, unauthorized third-party, and minor contributions are refused unless a separate lawful process exists.
Every sold product freezes the exact potential resale contributions and attribution weights totaling 1,000,000 ppm before delivery.
Credits mature only from externally settled revenue with complete measured costs and disclosed refund consequences; estimates and unknown costs allocate nothing.
TTI profit is externally settled revenue minus receipted provider costs and matured contributor obligations; engagement and credits are not revenue.
GET inspection cannot consume an offer session, POST may consume only after complete validation, and no TTI or proxy access log may retain the raw session token.
Market snapshots expose aggregate funnel and integrity counts only; contributor identities, message pointers, session digests, and knowledge cannot enter the measurement projection.

Live broker or intake effects require an unexpired machine-readable activation admission whose passed evidence, exact terms ID, and HTTPS origin match runtime; the pilot admission grants no sale or payout authority.

Simulation receipts must declare synthetic fixtures, zero simulated-circuit external effects, no live admission/sale/payout authority, and forbidden revenue/profit recognition; they can never enter a live economic ledger.

A buyer query crosses TTI's direct authenticated boundary with a named buyer settlement, bounded use and context, sufficient USD budget, and explicit exclusion of personal, sensitive, Discord, and secret data; it is demand evidence, never a sale.

Locality matching may select only active self-addressed direct contributions whose licenses permit Union resale and whose normalized subject, locality, and requested optional time context match exactly.
The USD 10 locality offer freezes the exact buyer, query, matched contribution and license set, human-approved positive weights totaling 1,000,000 ppm, delivery promise, and expiry before settlement.

Fulfillment requires an authenticated externally settled receipt bound to the frozen offer and cites every frozen contribution exactly once; preparation, delivery, correction, entitlement, and revenue are distinct evidenced acts.

Locality discovery reactions are aggregate interest signals only: bot reactions are excluded, Discord identities never enter the snapshot, and no reaction becomes a buyer query, price acceptance, purchase, contribution, license, payment, entitlement, revenue, or message-use permission.

The locality sale boundary hires the declared x402 Services Section only for official v2 exact-EVM payment; TTI validates the frozen offer before payment, derives price, product, network, asset, and pay-to from admitted law, stores no raw payment payload, and treats every development-chain or testnet settlement as synthetic non-revenue.

Production x402 is fail-closed without one unexpired exact TTI activation read from TTI's witnessed settlement store that binds the verified Base enterprise account, six-decimal USDC asset evidence, pay-to, facilitator actor, contract, capability and cost receipts, buyer/refund/chargeback/maturity law, qualified reviews, and public HTTPS origin; injected facilitator clients or URLs and wrong forwarded origins are refused, and an atomic durable claim limits the activation to one settled $10 pilot sale.

A Discord buyer-pilot query exists only after the human invokes /locality-pilot with the exact displayed permanent non-personal-query consent token. TTI may retain the deliberately submitted bounded query fields and chat, vault, MCP, or A2A delivery interest under keyed pseudonyms for demand measurement, but requests no budget, establishes no price, records no Discord identifiers or interaction token, and imports no ordinary message; the admission forms no contribution, license, resale permission, offer, purchase, payment, entitlement, answer promise, revenue, credit, or profit.
